summary: Published node1’s approved release tree as the read-only rsync module `releases`. Node2 retrieved and verified the complete tree. Security restrictions and persistence passed before and after sequential node restarts.

Configured and enabled a hardened, chrooted rsyncd service on node1, bound to 10.100.216.10:873.
Restricted module and firewall access to node2; SELinux remains enforcing in rsync_t.
Preserved a root-only rollback copy at /etc/rsyncd.conf.pre-releases.
Retrieved the release tree to node2 with archive semantics, preserving modes and the `current -> v1` symlink.
Verified upload, private-module access, traversal, and non-node2 access are denied.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.
Removed temporary test artifacts; both nodes report zero failed systemd units.
